einzeiler: Discussion on U.S.-Israel military integration, Kash Patel's hearing, and the Houthis.
kurzfassung: Ryan and Emily discuss the potential merging of the U.S. and Israeli militaries with former Pentagon official David Pyne. The episode also covers Kash Patel's latest hearing on various topics. Finally, Ryan speaks with Yemeni journalist Hussain Al-Bukhaiti regarding the Houthis.
stichpunkte: Discussion with David Pyne on the merging of U.S. and Israeli militaries
Overview of Kash Patel's latest hearing on various topics
Conversation with Yemeni journalist Hussain Al-Bukhaiti about the Houthis
beschreibung:
On today's Wednesday show Ryan and Emily speak to Former Pentagon official David Pyne about the merging of the Israel U.S. militaries. After we look at Kash Patel's latest hearing on a myriad of topics and finally Ryan speaks to Yemeni journalist Hussain Al-Bukhaiti about the Houthis.
